accessibilityTab.reduceMotionDesc: Reduces the intensity of animations and transitions in the interface.
accessibilityTab.autoplayGifsDesc: Play GIF animations without needing to click them.
accessibilityTab.autoplayStickersDesc: Automatically animate stickers sent in chat.
accessibilityTab.ttsDesc: Allows synthesizing messages with the /tts command.

voiceVideoTab.voiceIsoFullDesc: Strictly isolates the human vocal frequency band (135Hz – 3900Hz) and completely cuts peripheral sounds, breathing, mechanical keyboard, mouse clicks and ambient noise.
voiceVideoTab.krispFullDesc: Adaptive spectral filter that analyzes vocal formants in real time and cancels continuous noise such as fans, air conditioning and microphone hiss.
voiceVideoTab.noiseGateDesc: Cuts noise when you are not speaking. Higher values (-32dB to -25dB) block very loud surrounding noise.
voiceVideoTab.antiDuckingDesc: Prevents Windows from lowering volume by 80% or muffling YouTube video and music audio when joining voice channels. Keeps studio output (48kHz stereo).
voiceVideoTab.echoCancelDesc: Prevents recapture by open speakers. Tip: keep it off if you use headphones to preserve maximum sound quality!
voiceVideoTab.agcDesc: Smoothly equalizes and compresses speech peaks to keep your volume stable.

notificationsTab.desktopNotifDesc: Show native Windows notifications when new messages arrive.
notificationsTab.messageSoundsDesc: Play the official SyncCord sound when a message is received.
notificationsTab.voiceSoundsDesc: Play sound alerts when members join or leave the call.
notificationsTab.taskbarBadgeDesc: Flashes the app icon to get attention when there are mentions.

windowsTab.startMinimizedDesc: Starts silently in the system tray without opening the main window.
windowsTab.minimizeToTrayDesc: When clicking the close (X) button, keeps SyncCord running in the background.

streamerTab.autoEnableDesc: Automatically detects streaming software like OBS Studio and Streamlabs.
streamerTab.hidePersonalDesc: Protects email, connections, notes and tags from being shown on stream.
streamerTab.hideInvitesDesc: Avoids unknown people invading the servers you are in.

advancedTab.devModeDesc: Exposes user, channel and message IDs in the context menu (right-click).
advancedTab.gpuAccelDesc: Uses the computer's graphics card to speed up SyncCord rendering.
advancedTab.webrtcDiagDesc: Generates detailed logs of packets, jitter and ping in voice calls.

activityTab.showActivityDesc: Automatically updates your status showing the game, code or music that is open.
activityTab.shareInCallDesc: Lets other call participants see what you are playing or watching.
